summary: An excerpt from a fiction work, 'Book 10 — part 69', in which Damian looks after Trish, who is distraught, putting her to bed in pajamas, wiping away her makeup and tears, and planning a day of visiting Jory's family, a walk in the hills and rest. Later, at their thirty-fifth and final date, Trish reveals she is leaving her job to return to Washington and the Hill, and Damian helps her pack her office over takeout Mexican food while they tease each other about their relationship and his feelings about her departure.
one_line: Damian comforts Trish and later helps her pack her office as she leaves academia to return to Washington, ending their romance.
key_facts: Damian puts Trish in fluffy jammies, wipes away her makeup and hot tears with a cool face-cloth, and runs his fingers over her fingernails, squeezing each one a little.
Damian tells Trish she is taking a personal day and that he will call the department secretary to say she will be in tomorrow.
Damian plans for Trish to see Jory and his family, so that she can see the boy whose life she saved.
Damian tells Trish that when she gets up in the morning she can make an appointment to see a grief counsellor or not.
Trish says 'Damian, you're a wonder,' and Damian replies, 'You inspire me, darling.'
Their thirty-fifth date was their last.
Damian notices boxes in Trish's office and she confirms, 'Yes,' that she is going back to Washington.
Trish realizes that everyone in the law department likely knew she had decided to return to the Hill, while Damian had only suspected it until that moment.
Their romance was no secret; the law department knew about Damian and the network engineers knew about Trish, and they took ribbing about 'mixed marriages' and 'interfaith dating.'
Damian says, 'Well, good for you,' putting on a brave face belied by the Fret wrinkles in his forehead.
Trish says she should have told him once she decided but did not want to do it over the phone.
Damian says he is glad she did not tell him over the phone and offers to take her to dinner anyway.
The movers are coming in the morning, and Damian offers to help Trish pack with burger king or taco bell food.
Trish chooses Mexican food, saying 'taco bell,' and Damian lets her pay, saying 'You're making the big bucks now.'
Damian is a conscientious packer, padding framed pictures and wrapping knick-knacks in individual sheets of spun fiber.
Damian reminds Trish that she always told him 'Hill Rats were Hill Rats for life.'
